title: AIGameDev discord
author: 00zoNL
selftext: Ola creators, Is there any discord for New AI game devs? if not are ppl wanna create one and join? I love to talk to others and share my experience so far. And get new insights, iam working now 2/3 months with Claude and Codex and play games for over 35 years. As many i always wanted to make or create a game, but it was to hard to do alone or i did not had the knowlage/patience when i got stuck. When know working and have decent progress you gonna respect the Gamedevs out there that make it possible to play games all this time <3.
